# W23 brief — auto-compaction fallback in the LlamaDock gateway. Do not edit this file.

Background: the Strata serve (upstream 8080) returns HTTP 400 with the body
{"type":"invalid_request_error","message":"prompt (N tokens) leaves no room to answer in the context (M); requests are never truncated"}
when a client's prompt exceeds the context. The DeepSeek Harness (DSH) client re-sends the FULL conversation
every turn and has no compaction, so long conversations die at the wall. The fix goes in the gateway
(tools/llamadock-proxy.mjs) so every client benefits.

## The user's hard requirement — REMOVABILITY
DSH may ship native compaction later. Design so the gateway feature can be removed cleanly:
- ALL compaction code lives in ONE clearly-marked, self-contained section with the header comment:
  `// === COMPACTION FALLBACK: remove this whole section when DSH ships native compaction (env LLAMADOCK_COMPACTION=0 disables it) ===`
- One entry-point function (e.g. `maybeCompactForContext(upstreamStatus, upstreamBody, requestBody)`) and ONE
  call site in the request path. No other code references it.
- Env kill switch: `LLAMADOCK_COMPACTION=0` disables the feature entirely (the request path behaves exactly as
  before). Default: ON.

## Feature spec
Trigger: the upstream response is HTTP 400 AND the JSON body's message matches
/prompt \((\d+) tokens\) leaves no room to answer in the context (\d+)\)/ — capture N (prompt tokens) and M (ctx).
Action, exactly once per request:
1. Budget = M - (the request's max_tokens if present, else 4096) - 512 margin.
2. From the request's `messages`: KEEP every leading system message and the FINAL user message verbatim
   (the current turn is never clipped — Unsloth's rule). Walk the remaining messages from NEWEST to OLDEST,
   keeping each while the estimated size fits the budget.
3. Tool/role messages whose content alone exceeds ~32K chars are kept but TRIMMED to the first 2K + last 2K
   chars with `"...[tool result elided]..."` between (Unsloth's tool-result budget).
4. Estimation: JSON-stringified chars/4 per message (rough is fine — the retry's own 400 is the truth).
Retry the upstream request exactly ONCE with the compacted body. If the retry also returns 400, forward the
retry's response unchanged (fail honestly). NEVER retry on any other status or error.
Scope: POST /v1/chat/completions only (streaming and non-streaming — the 400 arrives before any stream starts,
so the retry is safe for both).
Log: one line per action, e.g. `compaction: prompt 34066 > ctx 32768; kept system + newest k of n messages, est ~T tokens; retrying once`.

## Tests (the engine on 8080 is UP — do NOT restart it, do NOT touch strata.exe; only the 8090 gateway restarts)
1. Regression: a short normal chat completion via 8090 → 200 with a real completion, with LLAMADOCK_COMPACTION
   unset AND =0 (two runs).
2. Oversized: a chat completion whose single user message is ~70K tokens (repeat a paragraph; a rough estimate
   is fine) via 8090 → default (flag unset): expect HTTP 200 and a real completion (the compaction fired — confirm
   the log line). With LLAMADOCK_COMPACTION=0: expect the original 400 "leaves no room" body passed through.
3. Streaming: the same oversized request with "stream": true → the stream begins normally (no 400) and completes.
4. Restart only the 8090 gateway process for the code to take effect (find the node process listening on 8090
   running tools/llamadock-proxy.mjs and restart it the same way it was started). The gateway restart briefly
   interrupts 8090 — acceptable.
